meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给访谈播客视频配上时间同步的图形卡片，让画面更生动
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你有采访或播客视频,想加标题和重点提示又不重剪
copy.tagline_en: Add timed graphic cards to talking-head videos for a polished, lively look
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have interview or podcast footage and want to add graphics without re-editing

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会为一段已有的访谈/播客/说话视频,按说话内容配上定时出现的图形卡片(标题、底部信息条、数据标注、引文等),并生成带卡片的新 MP4;原视频画面保持不变。
howto.when: 当用户提到 “graphic overlays”“on-screen graphics”“package / dress up my video” 等说法时触发;只想要普通字幕时不触发。

say.text: 帮我把这段访谈视频加上动感标题和底部信息条,16:9 画布。
say.note: 会生成带卡片的新视频。

say.text: 给这个播客视频加引文卡片和数据标注,竖屏 9:16。
say.note: 卡片会按语音时间插入。

say.text: 把我这段说话视频包装一下,加底部信息条和侧栏,原画面不动。
say.note: 原视频保持原样,只叠加图形。

howto.what_en: Claude takes an existing talking-head/interview/podcast video and adds timed graphic cards (titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, PiP) according to the speech, then renders a new MP4; the original clip is unchanged.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions “graphic overlays”, “on-screen graphics”, “package / dress up my video”, or similar; plain-subtitle requests do not trigger it.

say_en.text: Add animated titles and lower-thirds to this interview video on a 16:9 canvas.
say_en.note: Renders a new 16:9 MP4 with those cards.

say_en.text: Add quote cards and data callouts to this podcast video, vertical 9:16.
say_en.note: Cards are placed in sync with the speech.

say_en.text: Dress up this talking video with lower-thirds and side panel; keep original.
say_en.note: Original video is kept as is; only overlays are added.
